# Where does the next ad dollar still pay?

> Free ad budget optimizer for multi-channel advertisers. Upload weekly spend and revenue per channel to see each channel's diminishing-returns curve, the marginal return on the next dollar, the best split of the same budget, and a back-test of the fit. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
